Published

Aug 20, 2026 at 05:00 AM EDT

Khaleda Rahman

National Correspondent

With less than three months to go before November's midterm elections, President Donald Trump's approval rating remains underwater in most states, bar a handful of reliably Republican strongholds that continue to give him positive marks on his job performance. [...] Nationally, 35 percent of voters approve of Trump's job performance while 59 percent disapprove as of August 19, leaving him significantly underwater with a net approval rating of -24, according to Civiqs' rolling online tracking poll of registered voters.
